correctness.rationale: Fixed-point image lemma makes each image-bearing block a rooted component with s chosen fixed image points; each other point in that root block contributes 1+su. Each nonempty satellite source block maps into one such root and contributes (1+su)^n-1; completely undefined blocks are isolated. The labeled exponential formula gives exp(z+vz sum_s binom(n,s)(tu)^s(1+su)^(n-s) exp(z((1+su)^n-1))). Independent direct brute force enumeration of all 5^4 partial maps on two 2-point blocks found 76 idempotents, 21 full-domain and 32 rank one, agreeing with formula. Rank mn-1 count mn^2 follows by one nonfixed point. Works including m=0 and n=1.
